authority: Operator decision returned in plans/fieldwise_operator_input_pack.md item 3, folded into Tier 3 by plans/fieldwise_tickets.md ticket 6. Recorded per CLAUDE.md §9.4; status per §12.2.
decision: The ethics self-assessment adopts all five candidate categories: personal data under GDPR (yes, limited), farmer commercial data (yes), human participants (yes, low risk), animal subjects (no), dual use and misuse (no). No third-country data transfer arises. Ethics committee approval is 'not yet determined' and the ELTE Data Protection Officer consultation is 'planned', both with the reasons the operator supplied on 2026-08-11.
why: The draft contains no ethics section (input pack item 3, 'Draft basis: Nothing'). phase_06_gate predicate g07_p06 requires a non-empty ethics_assessment.self_assessment_statement, and an omission or an unexplained 'N/A' fails it. The categories are grounded in project activities the draft does describe: the DrR web MVP holds farm contact details and field boundaries, AgroVIR farm data is commercially sensitive, and task T5.6 collects structured feedback from staff and farmers.

contradiction_resolved.what: The form had accepted personal_data_gdpr 'yes, limited' and human_participants 'yes, low risk' while answering that no Data Protection Officer had been consulted — contradicting the GDPR candidate's own text, which states that ELTE's DPO reviews the processing.
contradiction_resolved.resolution: The operator softened both answers on 2026-08-11: approval requirement 'not yet determined', DPO consultation 'planned', each with a statement Phase 6 writes into the self-assessment rather than leaving as a bare token. Neither costs anything at the gate.
contradiction_resolved.residual: ethics_issues_identified stays true, so Part A's ethics self-assessment table and Part B-2 §6 must both be completed. That follows from the accepted candidates, not from the amendment.

consumed_by: Phase 2 writes compliance_profile.json; Phase 6 writes the ethics self-assessment statement.
gate_effect: phase_06_gate g07_p06 can pass. No other gate reads this item.
